item.title: Press Coverage: Ohio State’s Roster Rebuild Accelerates Quickly As Buckeyes Land Five Transfers in One Day
item.description: Good things come to those who wait. It seemed to some that the sky was falling for Ohio State in the opening days of transfer portal mayhem, but the Buckeyes turned things around with six commitments in the last 48 hours. item.title: Ohio State Wide Receiver Mylan Graham Transferring to Notre Dame
item.description: Mylan Graham is headed to Notre Dame. The former Ohio State wide receiver committed to Notre Dame on Tuesday. He'll have three years of eligibility to use with the Irish. A five-star recruit and the No. 33 overall prospect in the 2024 class, Graham was viewed as one of Ohio State’s potential breakout candidates before he entered the portal on Jan. 4.
